name: status-mark
title: Status Mark
description: A status as a small mark, such as a conversation's, a connection's or a task's: a dot in its tone's colour (neutral, info, success, warning, destructive), a warning a ring and a danger a diamond so they are told apart by shape too, or a spinner while it is busy, in the text's colour with 2px lines so it is seen at a glance (still where the reader asks for less motion); `grey` where the page has no colour (a sidebar), the same shapes in greys; named for screen readers, its label in a tooltip on hover and while the keyboard is on its row. A status to read on screen is a Badge.
